steps.en: The system cannot decide when both addresses have the same or no date
steps.id: Sistem tidak bisa memutuskan bila kedua alamat bertanggal sama atau kosong

steps.en: The record is marked as an address conflict
The notice is temporarily suspended under a specific code
steps.id: Notice disuspend sementara dengan kode suspension tertentu

steps.en: The notice does not escalate while the officer decides
steps.id: Notice tidak naik tahap selama officer memutuskan
steps.why_en: The hold lifts by itself after a set number of days, even if no officer has decided.
steps.why_id: Suspend lepas sendiri setelah beberapa hari, walau belum ada officer yang memutuskan.

steps.en: Foreigner address conflicts also lead to a temporary suspension
steps.id: Konflik alamat warga asing juga berujung suspend sementara
steps.why_en: Foreigner records with conflicting addresses are not suspended; the first address is simply kept.
steps.why_id: Record warga asing dengan alamat bentrok tidak disuspend; alamat pertama saja yang dipakai.
